fixDecisions.carryAssertion: Test fix: assert lead-only .room sentinels are absent and only fresh worker scratch is present; carried Git tree remains explicitly checked.
fixDecisions.resumeJSONAssertions: Test fixes: parse the JSONL message section separately from blank-line-delimited worker setup prose; assert message metadata and build context on both hosts. Production prompt format unchanged.
fixDecisions.directoryCreation: Code fix: shared privateStateDirectory exclusive leaf creation and verifyPrivatePath for existing leaves; no private initializer exemptions added.
fixDecisions.ancestorSafety: An intermediate direct shared-initializer adoption changed a synthetic ancestor named room from 0755 to 0700. New regression reproduced it; final leaf-only creation preserves checkout ancestor permissions.
fixDecisions.processSafetyFixture: Full run exposed a test assuming process.cwd() cannot be an owned worker. Replaced that input with the explicit nonworker test directory. Production process cleanup unchanged.

spawnBenchmark.method: Synthetic Codex process starter; real tool routing, Git worktrees and registry. One tracked file, no submodules/dependencies/WIP; carry=false. One warmup excluded from each block. Each checkout resolved its own workspace sources through linked dependencies; roomd/relay were unchanged between revisions, shared differed only in test-env. Model/API startup and compiled-project setup are not measured.

blockLabels.current: Intermediate direct private initializer, before ancestor guard

spawnBenchmark.pairedMethod: Final source, alternating build enabled then disabled; first pair excluded, eight observations per mode. Disabled mode mocks only prepareWorkerBuildDir to bypass optional setup.
spawnBenchmark.limits: Small sequential samples; ranges overlap and host load was not monitored. Separate final/baseline block delta is not wholly attributable to build setup. Paired on/off medians differ by about 14 ms. All retained warm samples were below 650 ms.
